- Full plugin backups use a versioned JSON payload (`kind: 'bb-project-folders-backup'`, version 1) containing settings and all 11 durable tables: folders, folder_paths, thread_places, folder_rules, project_rules, project_order, execution_defaults, session_policies, preferences, item_styles, and folder_archives. Imports preserve row IDs and run in one transaction; invalid backups and imports during an active move or archive are rejected. In the current implementation, any queued messages unconditionally disqualify the thread: it checks `thread.queuedMessageCount > 0` and `sdk.threads.queuedMessages.list(...)` returning non-empty arrays, without inspecting scheduled delivery times (`sendAt`).
